title: The Nine as a psychological warfare experiment
summary: Greg Malatzi tells of The Nine as a psychological warfare experiment, about 1950s at Round Table Foundation, Maine, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: start around that time, too, with this idea that it was a side op, or that it was this early psychological warfare experiment where can we get,

plain: A researcher, Greg Malatzi, talks about The Nine, a group of beings that people in 1950s Maine said they contacted through a group called the Round Table Foundation. Drawing on the writer Peter Levenda, he says one idea is that this was a side operation, an early psychological warfare experiment. If so, the contact story would have been a test of how people could be influenced rather than a message from beyond.
